overlays.description: The overlays the chosen workflow mandates. newRun copies it from the route decision onto every run, alongside workflow and profile, and every record on disk carries it - but this schema did not declare it, so a reader checking which run fields exist would not have found it. Nothing validates run records against this schema today; the declaration is documentation.

revision.description: Monotonic write counter. A writer holding an older revision is refused (STALE_RUN_STATE) so a concurrent read-modify-write cannot drop the earlier writer's evidence.

feature_id.description: Set only when this run is bound to a durable Feature (see Feature.schema.json). Never required for standalone workflows.

phase_id.description: Set only alongside feature_id. See Phase.schema.json.

parent_run_id.description: The run this one continues from, if any -- distinct from feature/phase binding.
